card: ALIAS: The Techno-Pope; TechnoPope; The Technopope.
ROLE: Supreme visible techno-religious authority within the imperial hierarchy.
ROLE: Ceremonial officiant for the empire's highest honors before the galactic senate and imperial spectators.
TRAIT: His office joins temple-bank wealth, religious title, imperial logistics, senate spectacle, and medallion ceremony into one visible apparatus.
TRAIT: Commands enough institutional reach to require vast marble extraction for a new temple-bank.
TRAIT: Functions through offices, commissions, strongholds, and ceremonies more than through personal intimacy.
TRAIT: Important enough that his death is named as a notable imperial casualty.
RELATIONSHIP: Imperial Merchants Guild: commissions or employs the guild's marble acquisition mission for his temple-bank project.
RELATIONSHIP: steelhead__late (Steelhead): abducted him from the Techno-Techno stronghold and brought him to Philodendra.
RELATIONSHIP: aghora (Aghora): placed the pluri-galactic medallion around Aghora's neck during the imperial award ceremony.
RELATIONSHIP: deyanira (Deyanira): the tarantuwolf's savage fury reaches him during the award ceremony and violently ends his role in it.
VOICE: No substantive private dialogue is established; render him through ceremonial formula, institutional authority, and delegated power rather than confession.
INSTRUCTION: Before Aghora's award ceremony, make his power procedural and architectural: a requisition, a stronghold, a title, a hall, a medal, a crowd.
INSTRUCTION: Do not invent a private theology, remorse, ambition, or inner contradiction beyond what his public office and witnessed actions support.
BOUNDARY: Do not preannounce the award ceremony's violent outcome; let the medallion rite read as imperial triumph until the scene itself breaks.
phase_boundary_note: Single merged identity across Techno-Pope/TechnoPope/Technopope naming variants; treat phase differences as the same office-bearing person moving from offscreen institutional commissioner to abducted authority to public award officiant.
source_strategy: Source-thin card kept deliberately institutional and procedural: uses only the marble temple-bank commission, Steelhead abduction witness fact, Aghora medallion ceremony, Deyanira ceremony violence, and recap casualty status; wiki and matrix used only for orientation, not added biography.
